name: New Chandigarh
shortDescription: Premium 42-acre farm land available for sale in New Chandigarh, strategically located near Sukhvilas.
longDescription:
Premium 42-acre farm land available for sale in New Chandigarh, strategically located near Sukhvilas. This expansive land parcel offers an excellent opportunity for investors, farmhouse development, agricultural use, or long-term investment in one of the region’s developing and sought-after areas.

The property enjoys a peaceful green surroundings while benefiting from the growing infrastructure and connectivity of New Chandigarh. Its proximity to Sukhvilas adds to the location’s appeal, making it suitable for buyers looking for a large land parcel away from the congestion of the city while remaining well connected to Chandigarh and Mohali.

With 42 acres of land, the property provides ample space and flexibility for various permissible uses, subject to applicable zoning, land-use regulations, and approvals.

Property Highlights:

42 Acres Premium Farm Land
Located in New Chandigarh
Near Sukhvilas
Peaceful & Green Surroundings
Suitable for Investment / Farmhouse Potential
Excellent Future Growth Potential
Well-connected location
Suitable for Long-Term Investment

For Sale – Serious buyers and investors can contact NestNeev Real Estate for further property details, location information and site visit.
